upgrade-notes.advisories-block: TRANSITIONAL. config.policy.advisories.block is false only while climbing the Laravel 5.7 -> 13 ladder. Every end-of-life version in between, and its whole transitive tree, carries advisories; Composer 2.10 refuses to install them, so the climb is impossible with the block on. This is not a decision to tolerate vulnerabilities: production stays on 5.7 throughout and no intermediate version is ever deployed. For reference, 5.7.29 (production today) is affected by 9 laravel/framework advisories and 5.8.38 by 8, so each hop reduces exposure.
upgrade-notes.advisories-block-removal: MUST be restored to true, and `composer audit` must be clean, before anything reaches production. Tests\Feature\AdvisoryPolicyTest fails the build if the installed framework reaches Laravel 13 while this is still false.
upgrade-notes.platform-php: config.platform.php pins the PHP version dependency resolution targets, independently of whichever PHP runs composer. Bump it at each PHP hop: 7.4.33 -> 8.0 -> 8.1 -> 8.2 -> 8.3+.
